description: Random Prompt Builder V2 configuration. Prompt text starts intentionally empty and should be filled gradually.

categories.label: Subject
categories.description: Generated subject category; establishes subject state used by later categories.

categories.label: Ethnicity
categories.description: Ethnicity and compatible skin-tone category. No active downstream category depends on ethnicity state, so validation resolves after the dependency-producing categories.

categories.label: Body Build
categories.description: General whole-body build category. No active downstream category depends on body-build state, so validation resolves after the dependency-producing categories while prompt output stays early.

categories.label: Body Detail
categories.description: Regional body detail category. It depends on Subject state, but no active downstream category depends on body-detail state, so validation resolves after the dependency-producing chain while prompt output stays before Clothing.

categories.label: Clothing
categories.description: Clothing category; resolves after Environment so clothing theme state exists, and before Action so clothing.action.* state exists.

categories.label: Action
categories.description: Action category for subject activity and movement context. Random Action validates against the internal activity.route state; manual override text bypasses that random route.

categories.label: Pose
categories.description: Pose category for static posture/form/expression. Random Pose validates against the internal activity.route state; manual override text bypasses that random route.

categories.label: Environment
categories.description: Environment category for setting and scene context; resolves immediately after Subject because Clothing and Action depend on environment domain/location/theme/room/surface state.

categories.label: Composition
categories.description: Composition category for framing, focus/perspective, and simple camera angle or position decisions.

categories.label: Lighting
categories.description: Lighting category placeholder for scene light and mood.

categories.label: Style
categories.description: Image style category placeholder, separate from clothing style.

categories.label: Quality
categories.description: Quality category placeholder for final quality/detail prompt terms.
